# Nullary carrier with a closed Object tail

Owned Java corpus for `<K> Map<K,Object> make()`. The provider returns its actual
shared input-controlled result after initialization, effects, mutation and ordered
failures. The caller keeps the complete scoped method Signature, original result
identity and delayed key/value casts. Four caller routes, three consumers and
sixteen modes run twice in fresh JVMs. The observer independently verifies the
single method formal and literal Object tail through generic reflection.
Source and immutable SDK-JAR profiles compile every generated source, account all
classes/methods/helpers and preserve original metadata and ordered Exceptions.
Same-Code Signature controls and independent bypass/repeated-call programs must
fail. No private sample material or third-party source is included.
